added_failures_note: measured zero: the reviewed manifest records baseline_suite and after_suite as not-run with the plan's stated reason that no product source changes, so no arm log exists to derive added failures from; a suite-arm count is owed by a separate test node per this node's evidence fence.

assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: The shared counter tests/equilibrium/test_topology_read.py:_jaxpr_equation_counts changes how it counts a nested jit body, so it no longer returns five unique and seven expanded equations for _twice.
attribute_graph double-counts a nested equation or stops descending into a nested jaxpr, returning other than 7 expanded equations.
The per-equation sources increment at scripts/prototypes/order2/attribution.py:76 is removed or moved outside the equation loop, so the ranking no longer partitions the expanded total.
_source_owner returns the unattributed sentinel, for example if ROOT at scripts/prototypes/order2/attribution.py:6 resolves to the wrong parent or the project-frame filter drops every frame.

A row whose compile hit the persistent cache would record a hit, but row.py:31 and row.py:276 disable the cache, so the ledger is empty, row.py:277 writes the miss itself and this assertion cannot fail.

findings.text: follow-on: the per-row cache-miss assertion cannot fail. With JAX_ENABLE_COMPILATION_CACHE false (row.py:31, row.py:276) cache_guard records no rows, so the driver writes its own miss at row.py:277 and then asserts at row.py:287 that it is there and that hits are zero; hit_count is trivially zero because no lookup is ever instrumented, so brief.txt:9's 'each row asserting its own cache miss from the cache-guard rows' is satisfied in form only. Cold-ness genuinely rests on the cache being disabled before JAX initialises plus the import-time assertion at row.py:31, and the ledger prose discloses the synthesis, so the node need not be held for it.

follow-on: _source_owner unpacks the per-equation frame lines at attribution.py:16 and discards them, so the emitted ranking line is the owner function's co_firstlineno rather than the line of each contributing equation; done_when item 3 asks only for owner file and line so the delivered ledger satisfies the clause, but brief.txt:10's 'file and line from each equation's traceback' is not what the code records and a reader cannot locate the contributing equations from the table.
